events.action: {"message": "Fixed a `net_pkt` leak in `net_ipv6_send_ns()` in `subsys/net/ip/ipv6_nbr.c`. When a neighbor already had a non-empty `pending_queue`, the newly incoming pending packet was appended to the queue and the function returned early without sending the allocated Neighbor Solicitation `pkt`, leaking `pkt` and its associated buffer. Added `net_pkt_unref(pkt)` before returning in that branch. All 55 tests in `tests/net/ipv6` now pass.", "kind": "FinishAction"}
